column4: cleat#3245 Phase 3 step 2 piece 4d: both tests open a *PostgresStore directly via testutil.TestDB(t, testutil.DialectPostgres) (continueAsNewLeaseTestStore), which skips on CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES alone regardless of what else is set -- workflow_leases/workflow_payloads are PostgreSQL-only (the issue's own scoping decision, same as pieces 2/3/4a/4b/4c's tests), so these two have no MySQL or MSSQL form to run instead. multi-db/mysql sets CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and not CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES, so both skip here. 2 skips, not a subtest group -- same shape as heartbeat-updates-the-lease-rows.tsv's three.
same two tests, same reason: multi-db/mssql sets CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL and not CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES, so both skip here too -- see the multi-db/mysql line above.
